entries.stanceLine: Breakouts suspect in both directions today — 271% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.

signals.text: 271% of a typical day's range is already spent — fresh breakouts have little fuel; favour fades back into the range over chasing.
The obvious draw (PDL 10587.9) sits beyond what's left of a typical day's range — targets past it are stretch-only today.
Sterling is at the 100th percentile of its 20-day range and still rising — a persistent FX headwind capping upside breaks (weak GBP is what lifts FTSE).
FTSE is tracking a firmer European tape (Euro Stoxx +2.13%) — the cross-market lean is up.
GBP is a crowded short — a short-squeeze higher in sterling is a latent slap for upside breaks (strong GBP weighs on FTSE).
